text:
sqlpipe v2.0 brings a breaking API update, faster data exports, and a new incremental workflow.

Breaking change: `/v2/users` no longer returns a single `name` field. It now provides `first_name` and `last_name`. Update clients, serializers, and downstream transformations before upgrading.

The new `--incremental` flag lets you process only records changed since the previous run, reducing unnecessary work and making recurring pipelines more efficient. Use it for scheduled syncs and large datasets where full exports are costly.

Parquet writes are now up to 40% faster, improving end-to-end pipeline performance without requiring configuration changes.

Review integrations for the `/v2/users` schema change, test incremental runs against your source data, and then upgrade to sqlpipe v2.0.
